run_evaluate_ego4d_nlq: run the Ego4D NLQ evaluation script with ground truth and model prediction JSON files
compute_IoU: compute the Intersection over Union between predicted and ground truth temporal windows
evaluate_nlq_performance: evaluate NLQ model performance by comparing predictions against ground truth annotations
display_results: display evaluation results as an ASCII table with Rank@K and mIoU@threshold metrics
review_evaluate_ego4d_nlq: review the Ego4D NLQ evaluation script to understand IoU computation and recall metrics
